text: This is my second time getting braces. I had them 12 years ago at another clinic. Dr. Ing gave good advice (my front teeth are misaligned; the doctor suggested implants, costing 4500-5000 baht, but it's optional. If I do it, treatment will take up to 5 years. The X-ray also showed a root problem with one tooth and a chance of one front tooth dying, but the doctor said it might not happen). The treatment plan is for 2-3 years. I'm a little worried and scared because I'm older now, and I've been afraid of dentists since I was a child. I'm getting braces because my teeth feel spaced out, my front teeth protrude, and they're starting to become crooked (I didn't wear my retainer regularly). I've read good reviews, and it's close to home. I'll give it a try and share my review later. Currently, the braces cost is 2100 baht for cleaning and scaling (900 baht under social security, plus 400 baht for the rest). The first time the braces are fitted is on August 19th, 2025 (upper teeth, lower teeth not yet fitted; the doctor said to adjust). The doctor asked... We chose the orthodontic treatment package, Package 1, priced at 37,000 baht. The first four months were paid at 3,000 baht each, followed by 1,000 baht per month thereafter. The first payment included a brush set and service fee of 350 baht, bringing the total to 3,350 baht. On 23/9/68, the rubber bands were changed, the lower braces were reattached, and the front teeth were hitting the braces, requiring the last tooth on each side to be lifted (1,000 baht). The total cost was 4,100 baht. The tooth lifting caused a malocclusion; I can't bite properly and have to eat soft foods in small bites for now. On 26/10/68, the wire at the back came loose from the bracket. I had to see the dentist urgently and also got my teeth stained (3,100 baht).
